newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Bangladesh's new President Shahabuddin Ahmed has suggested a temporary ban on student politics to put an end to campus violence. "If national interest requires, so-called student politics should be suspended temporarily," Ahmed said.
A three-man delegation leaves Dhaka on Monday on a 11-day visit to some European countries to explore market for Bangladeshi tea.

Export of Bangladeshi shrimp to the United States may face crisis in the wake of a U.S. court order banning import of shrimp from nations which have not been certified under the Public Law of U.S. Local shrimp exporters said most Asian nations, excepting Sri Lanka and Indonesia, would be affected by the court order.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina asked the Planning Commission and other government agencies to draw up specific programmes and projects for boosting rural economy.
Foreign portfolio investors offloaded shares worth nearly $75 million taking advantage of recent buoyancy in the market.
The government is planning to set up two more Export Processing Zones (EPZs) in the port cities of Chittagong and Khulna, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said.
